mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version Numbering Scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use semantic versioning (semver) for release versioning, with explicit major.minor.patch numbers tied to backward-compatibility guarantees. The rationale is that tracking API compatibility matters more than signalling publication dates: breaking changes are communicated through major version increments, which tells downstream consumers where to expect API changes.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
